about_the_game:
Welcome to the dark streets of prohibition-era New York City, where opportunity comes to those bold enough to seize it.

You start with nothing but ambition and a few dollars in your pocket. Your first break comes when a local boss takes notice of your potential and offers you a chance to prove yourself. What begins as small-time work quickly grows into something much bigger.

Build Your Criminal Network

Invest in over 20 different illegal operations across the city. Run speakeasies where the booze flows freely, operate gambling halls where fortunes change hands nightly, and control protection rackets that keep businesses "safe." Each operation comes with its own unique owner who has stories to tell and wisdom to share.

From Mae's underground speakeasy to Mickey's smuggling operation at the docks, you'll meet dozens of colorful characters who each play a part in your rise to power. Every business tells a story, and every upgrade brings you deeper into the world of organized crime.

Fight for Territory

When diplomacy fails, bullets fly. Face off against rival hitmen in intense shootouts where quick reflexes and smart upgrades mean the difference between victory and defeat. Each enemy you defeat brings you closer to controlling the city's underworld.

Rise Through the Ranks

When you've built your empire as far as it can go, it's time to start over - but not empty-handed. The Underground Market offers powerful permanent upgrades that make each new attempt stronger than the last. Climb the hierarchy from street thug to underboss to the ultimate crime lord.

A Complete Story

This isn't an endless grind. Your criminal career has a beginning, middle, and end. Experience a complete narrative as you rise from nobody to somebody in the most dangerous business in America.

The city is waiting. How far will you go to rule it all?

Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM

short_description: Build your criminal empire in 1920s New York. Start small and work your way up through speakeasies, gambling dens, and protection rackets. Fight rival hitmen, meet colorful characters, and become the city's most powerful crime lord.
